main_text.head: EPIST. XXXVII.
Thomas Comberus J. Morino, De exem-plari quodam M. S. Pent. Samarit, quod erat in Anglia.
Reverendo admodum Doctissimoque Viro D. J. Morino, Congregationis Oratorii Presbytero.

p.i: Reverende admodum D. Vir Clarissime Doctissimeque.

main_text.p: CUm rescissem partim ex fama, ad nos per librarios perlata, partim ex prae-viis quibusdam lucubrationibus tuis, edi-tionem Bibliorum SS. instructissimam, & caeteris omnibus locupletiorem Pari-siis à vobis adornari, avide sane aures animumque adverti, maxime verò prae-ter additamenta, ornamentaque caetera, Samaritanam quoq; supellectilem nobis Europaeis hactenus per secula complura incognitam, & à paucis aliquot deside-rari jam coeptam eidem accessuram esse, equidem serio gaudebam. Dabit ea res cùm utilitatem, quod tu affatim doces, multiplicem ; tum etiam voluptatem è

page.notes: The catchword "P re" is spaced across the foot of the page; the second word is uncertain. The large initial C is joined to "Um" as "CUm". Hyphens at line ends are printed hyphens. Heading levels for the title and dedication lines are judgements based on their italic, centred setting.
